page.overview:
What is Ancient Weapons?

The are three weapons capable of mass destruction, each taking a different form. They are known as Pluton, Poseidon, and Uranus, each named after a deity for their godly powers. The weapons are not limited only to inanimate objects, but consist of living beings as well.

Ancient Weapons used during the initial Great War during the Void Century and are majorly responsible for the rise of global sea levels that shaped much of the current Blue Planet geography. The ancient pirate Joy Boy had a role in their preservation so future generations could still access and use the weapons, but his reasons for doing so are still a complete mystery.

The Ancient Weapons are the argument used by the World Government to forbid research of the Void Century, since they fear that knowledge of the weapons could result in a global war. However, this has not stopped certain individuals, such as the former Warlord Crocodile, the government agent Spandam, and most notably the former members of the Four Emperors, Charlotte Linlin and Kaidou, from attempting to gain one or even all of the weapons for themselves. Even without knowledge of the missing years, their power has been known to entice casual observers (as was the case with Vander Decken IX's interest in Shirahoshi, otherwise known as the Ancient Weapon Poseidon).

While Pluton has yet to appear in the story, it has been confirmed to be an ancient battleship capable of massive damage and destruction. It was built on the island of Water 7 sometime during the Void Century, though the precise reason for its construction remains unknown. It currently rests within a secret cavern at the foot of the submerged Mt. Fuji in old Wano Country, below the cavern where Wano's Road Poneglyph is currently hidden. Since the Arabasta Poneglyph contains the location of Pluton, the battleship must have been brought to Wano shortly after its construction. In order for Pluton to be released, the mountainous walls surrounding Wano would have to be brought down; this is the true meaning of "opening Wano's borders".
